title: Sun Yat Sen

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
F. O. REG
No. 394
Dat 17/6/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA JUVANT）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

June 18th 1916.

Sir,
At 3 p.m. 15th instant a meeting was held in a house in Yu Tsung Li 頤春里 Avenue Joffre by some persons who took a prominent part in the anti-Yuan movement. The meeting was presided over by Sun Yat Sen 孫逸仙 and amongst those present were Tang Shao Yi, Wu Ting Fang and Nyeu Tih Sung 鈕鐵生。 It was held for the purpose of determining the attitude to be taken up in connection with a request made by the new President that the provinces, which had severed connection with Peking, cancel their independence. After some discussion it was unanimously agreed to send a telegram to the Central Government demanding that the officials who had taken part in the monarchical movement be severely punished and threatening that the independent provinces will remain as they are till this is done.
Deputy Military Governor Lu of Woosung has been granted one weeks leave dating from yesterday.
It is reported that General Yang has sent a telegram to President Li urging the severe punishment of the Monarchical party.
The military officer named Fong Kung San who came here in connection with General Yang's suggestion that some of the troops be withdrawn from Shanghai, returned to Nanking on 18th inst.

Your Obedient Servant,

[Signature]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事调查处
外交部登记
编号 394
日期 16/6/17

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处 同心协力）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年6月18日。

先生：

本月15日下午3时，一些在反袁运动中起主要作用的人士在霞飞路颐春里的一处住宅内举行会议。会议由孙逸仙主持，出席者包括唐绍仪、伍廷芳和钮铁生。会议旨在确定针对新任大总统要求已与北京断绝关系的各省取消独立这一请求所应采取的态度。经讨论后，与会者一致同意向中央政府发送电报，要求严惩参与帝制运动的官员，并威胁称在此事完成之前，独立各省将维持现状。

吴淞副督军卢氏已获准休假一周，自昨日起生效。

据报，杨将军已向黎大总统发出电报，敦促严惩帝制派。

因杨将军建议从上海撤出部分部队而前来的名为 Fong Kung San (音译) 的军官，已于本月18日返回南京。

您顺从的仆人，

[签名]

首席探长。

警务处巡官队长。
